newsitem.title: EGYPT: Italy minister in Egypt for Alamein anniversary.
newsitem.headline: Italy minister in Egypt for Alamein anniversary.

text.p: Italian Defence Minister Beniamino Andreatta arrived in Cairo on Friday for talks with Egyptian officials and to attend memorial services marking the anniversary of the Battle of el-Alamein.

Commonwealth forces led by British General Bernard Montgomery launched a huge offensive against Italian and German forces under Rommel on October 23, 1942, at el-Alamein, on Egypt's Mediterranean coast.
Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi will fly to Cairo on Sunday for talks with President Hosni Mubarak, Prodi's office said on Friday.
A statement said the October 20-21 working visit followed an invitation from the Egyptian president.
Prodi's visit to Egypt will be his first to the Middle East since he was appointed prime minister in May. Italy is eager to play a greater role in the peace process
